name: FabTally EmailAuth
description: Scriptable DMARC/SPF/DKIM email-authentication validation for CI/CD and agents — a pay-per-call alternative to MX Toolbox. Full check returns per-mechanism PASS/WARN/FAIL with a plain-English summary and fix hints ($0.003; single-mechanism $0.001). DNS-only, read-only, stateless, no PII. x402 USDC on Base; also a GitHub Action.
